Privacy policy

Effective 27 September 2026

Optical Bench is an educational optics simulator by Chuang Lu. Its calculations run on your device. The app does not require an account.

Data kept on your device

The iPhone app stores your experiment settings and a manually saved experiment on your iPhone so you can continue later. The app does not send those settings or calculation results to a server. Deleting the app removes its locally stored data.

Sharing and external links

If you choose to share an image, iOS sends it only to the destination you select in the system share sheet. The app includes optional links to third-party educational sources and an email contact link. Opening those links leaves the app and is subject to the destination's own privacy practices.

Analytics and advertising

The app does not include advertising, analytics, or tracking tools.

Contact

Questions about this policy: luchuangl@gmail.com.
